national_news.title: Rohit Yadav and Murali Sreeshankar Win Titles at World Athletics Continental Tour 2026
bullets: Rohit Yadav secured the men's javelin throw title with a personal best mark of 87.68 metres at the World Athletics Silver Level Continental Tour 2026 held at Kalinga Stadium, Bhubaneswar.
Murali Sreeshankar clinched the men's long jump title with an 8.07-metre jump, while Ancy Sojan led an Indian sweep in the women's long jump with a winning effort of 6.71 metres.
Teenager Abinaya Rajarajan won the women's 100-metre event in 11.34 seconds, setting a new Indian Under-20 national record.

national_news.title: India Must Move from 'Pharmacy' to 'Laboratory of the World': Union Minister Anupriya Patel
bullets: Union Minister of State for Health and Family Welfare Anupriya Patel addressed the 3rd edition of the IIMA Healthcare Summit on 'Advancing AI in Healthcare' at IIM Ahmedabad.
Highlighted the setting up of Centres of Excellence for AI in healthcare at AIIMS New Delhi, PGIMER Chandigarh, and AIIMS Rishikesh.
Emphasized the ₹5,000 crore Promotion of Research and Innovation in Pharma-MedTech Sector (PRIP) scheme to boost innovation-led industry-academia research collaboration.

national_news.title: Centre Formed High-Level Committee for Gorkha Issue and Reviews Siliguri Corridor Security
bullets: Union Home Ministry announced the formation of a high-level committee chaired by Interlocutor Pankaj Singh (former BSF Director and Deputy NSA) to resolve Gorkha issues in the Darjeeling Hills, Terai, and Dooars within the constitutional framework.
Union Home Minister Amit Shah reviewed security arrangements along India's eastern borders at Sukna, Siliguri, focusing on strengthening the Siliguri Corridor ('Chicken's Neck').

Central security forces (BSF, SSB) and state administration discussed preparing a framework for a proposed 'Triangular Security Grid' near the international borders with Nepal, Bhutan, and Bangladesh.

national_news.title: BRICS Youth Ministers' Meeting Concludes in Visakhapatnam with Joint Statement
bullets: The BRICS Youth Ministers’ Meeting concluded in Visakhapatnam, adopting a Joint Statement focusing on youth cooperation in education, skills, entrepreneurship, innovation, and social development.
Union Minister for Youth Affairs and Sports Dr. Mansukh Mandaviya highlighted the MY Bharat platform, noting it has surpassed 25 million registered young citizens.
India held bilateral talks on the sidelines with South Africa and the UAE to enhance cooperation in skills, youth exchanges, and digital engagement.

national_news.title: 14th BRICS STI Ministerial Meeting Held in Chennai Under India's Presidency
bullets: Union Minister of State for Science and Technology Dr. Jitendra Singh addressed the 14th BRICS Science, Technology, and Innovation (STI) Ministerial Meeting in Chennai, Tamil Nadu.
The official theme for India's BRICS Presidency 2026 in STI is 'Building for Resilience, Innovation, Cooperation and Sustainability'.

India called for deeper cooperation in frontier technologies (AI, Quantum, Biotechnology, Photonics) and highlighted national initiatives including the National Quantum Mission, National Supercomputing Mission, and BioE3 Policy.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Government Clarifies ₹4 Lakh Limit Under Student Credit Card Scheme
bullets: The Bihar government clarified that higher education loans up to ₹4 lakh will continue to be made available under the Bihar Student Credit Card Scheme.
Under the revised mechanism, the Bihar State Education Finance Corporation will extend loans up to ₹2 lakh, while scheduled commercial banks will provide the remaining amount up to ₹4 lakh.
The scheme has been linked with the PM Vidyalaxmi portal and PM Uchchatar Shiksha Protsahan Yojana, with expenditure approval raised to ₹950 crore for 2026-27.

bihar_news.title: Union Govt Sanctions ₹13,427 Crore for 11.19 Lakh PMAY Houses in Bihar
bullets: Union Rural Development Minister Shivraj Singh Chouhan approved 11,18,937 pucca houses for Bihar under the Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana (PMAY) with a financial outlay of ₹13,427 crore.
Over the last two years, a cumulative total of 24,30,327 houses involving an expenditure of ₹29,164 crore have been sanctioned for the state.
The announcement also featured the implementation of Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY) in Bihar and the creation of district-level 'She-Marts' to promote Jeevika Self-Help Group products.
